statusNote.en: Red Giant was acquired by Maxon; Magic Bullet is now sold as part of the Red Giant product line under Maxon.

keyLimits.en: Includes the full Red Giant toolkit (100+ tools) including Magic Bullet Looks, Trapcode Particular/Form, Universe plugin library, and Maxon Studio templates. Exact price not published on the fetched page; a downloadable trial is offered.

cautions.en: Magic Bullet is not sold standalone on the fetched page; it is bundled inside the Red Giant Complete annual subscription alongside dozens of other plugins.

capabilities.en: Magic Bullet Looks provides cinematic color grading and film emulation presets as a plugin for host video editors.
Part of the wider Red Giant toolkit offering particle systems, lens flares, keying/compositing, and motion graphics tools.
Integrates as plugins directly inside After Effects, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Apple Motion, Final Cut Pro, and Avid Media Composer.

limitations.en: Not a standalone application; requires a supported host video editor (After Effects, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, etc.) to run.
Exact subscription price and whether Magic Bullet alone can be purchased separately from the full Red Giant bundle was not shown on the fetched page.

reason.en: DaVinci Resolve includes built-in color grading tools that can substitute for Magic Bullet's color plugins in many workflows.

unknowns: Exact monthly/annual subscription price for Red Giant Complete not published on the fetched page; the seed's cached price could not be re-verified.
Whether Magic Bullet Looks can be purchased as a standalone product separate from the full Red Giant bundle.
